# czc-v2026.10.29.4 (0.2.19.5)

Account management now uses the requested delinquency rule for OpenAI
subscription dates and displays only two plain date lines: "到期 YYYY-MM-DD"
and "宽限 YYYY-MM-DD". There are no extra active/ended grace-period labels.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.29.3

- A non-delinquent account displays the upstream entitlement `expires_at`.
  A delinquent account displays that date minus one local calendar month,
  retaining the time and clamping to the last valid day of the previous month.
  For example, November 28 becomes October 28; March 31 becomes February 28
  or February 29 in a leap year.
- Grace is computed from the adjusted date: Pro tiers use 14 fixed 24-hour
  days; Plus uses 30. Other providers and plans retain their existing behavior.
- The backend captures nullable `is_delinquent` alongside the raw entitlement
  date. `false` is preserved, and an unknown state is not treated as delinquent.
  Raw stored dates are not shifted, avoiding repeated month subtraction.
- OAuth credential creation/refresh, reauthorization, Codex imports, CRS sync,
  admin detail/list responses and credential shadows propagate the paired
  subscription metadata. A newer date without a state clears an older flag.
- Changing ChatGPT identity or plan without a new date clears old subscription
  metadata. Observed 429 plan changes do the same. Confirmed personal-account
  Pro/Plus plan changes keep the displayed plan and subscription data aligned,
  while generic Pro responses preserve specific Pro tier names.
- The removed status labels also remove their timers. Tooltips retain the
  complete local date/time. These display rules do not change scheduling,
  administrator-configured account expiry or upstream entitlements.

## VERSION

`0.2.19.5`

## Upgrade and compatibility

- No schema migration or new configuration is required. The additional
  credential/parent field is optional and is compatible with existing data.
- Build the frontend immediately before the embedded server from this tag,
  install the binary and restart `sub2api.service`.
- Existing active paid accounts need one entitlement lookup to populate the
  missing delinquency state. This deployment uses a conditional metadata-only
  backfill for accounts with direct connections, then restarts the service.
  It validates identity/plan and avoids overwriting concurrent token or date
  changes. Tokens and unrelated settings are not changed.
- Accounts whose state remains unknown retain the date without month
  subtraction until a successful upstream lookup supplies a boolean.
- The month subtraction is the operator-requested rule; it is not a paid
  invoice verification. Dates use the browser's local timezone.

## Rollback

Restore the pre-install binary saved as
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.29.4-<UTC timestamp>`, or redeploy
`czc-v2026.10.29.3`, and restart `sub2api.service`. Confirm homepage HTTP 200,
binary VERSION and the origin release URL.

The metadata-only backfill is backed up under
`/opt/sub2api/backups/subscription-delinquency-<UTC timestamp>.json` without
tokens. Older code ignores the new flag and shows the raw entitlement date;
if restoring previous display metadata, restore only the two backed-up keys
for unchanged accounts, preserving newer tokens and settings. No schema
rollback is necessary.
